description: Public Ed25519 keys that sign DevMatrix evidence. A signature is accepted only when its key_id and its inline public_key are one entry here, the entry's class is "production", and its signed_at falls inside that entry's window. signed_at is claimed by the signer, not covered by the signature: a window bounds the time a signature may claim, it does not protect against a retired private key that leaked. anchor says whether the key was also published independently of this repository.

keys.window: first and last signature of this key in this repository; the key was replaced
keys.anchor: self-declared by the evidence it signed; retired

keys.window: from the first signature of this key in this repository; current key
keys.anchor: pending: to be published by DevMatrix independently of this repository
